evaluation.feedback: The syncopated rhythm and clean guitar production are very catchy and give the track a professional Afro-pop or modern R&B feel. The minor key adds a nice touch of moodiness without losing the energy. It works well as a high-quality backing track, though it lacks a lead vocal or melodic hook to make it a complete song.
evaluation.suggested_prompt: Make an upbeat Afro-pop song with a syncopated drum beat, clean electric guitar riffs in C minor, and a smooth male vocal melody.
